༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs mchod zab don snying khu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru badzra wā ra hi/skyabs gnas kun 'dus mkha'

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs mchod zab don snying khu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra wā ra hi/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus mkha' spyod dbang mo dang / /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro mchod pas mnyes phyir du/ /zab don snying khu tshogs mchod cho ga bri/ /'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos mtha' dag gi yang rtse skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag la dus 'dir mchog gi dngos grub 'bad med du rtsol ba'i dpe tshig brgyud dang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu bsngags pa'i don bzhin mi bslu ba'i bdag nyid dpal mo mkha' spyod dga' ma'i tshogs mchod dam pa mang po'i gsung rabs las 'byung ba bzhin lhan cig tu rang gzhan 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir bkod pa la/ spyi don dang gzhung don gnyis las/ dang po ni dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rnam par bshad pa bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ ༈ /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dzaḥye/ 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rnam gzhag cung zad bshad par bya ba la don gnyis te/ rgyun gyi dang / khyad par gyis so/ /dang po la bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa'i tshul/ de ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul/ bsten pa las byung ba'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni rgyud las/ na dang ga ha dang po dang / /mtha' yi sha dang dang po'i sha /kyai rdo rje'i dngos grub phyir/ /bdud rtsi lnga yang de bzhin bza'/ /zhes sogs dang / saṃ ṭa las/ ye shes lcags kyu rab dbye bas/ /yid kyi thams cad 'gugs pa'o/ /zhes dang / phyag thig las/ mi bskyod pa ni dri yi chu/ /rin chen dbang po'i khrag ces bshad/ /snang ba mtha' yas khu bar brjod/ /don yod grub pa sha chen te/

/rnam par snang mdzad rtug par bshad/ /'di rnams bdud rtsi lnga mchog go /zhes sogs kyi rdzas dang / rtsa rgyud las/ dang por rnam snang de rjes su/ /rdo rje ma yi mtha' ru hūm̐/ /bza' ba dang btung ba byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags so/ /zhes dang / saṃ ṭa las/ ha yis kha dog 'phrog par byed/ /hoḥs ni dri ni 'jig par byed/ /hrīḥni brtson 'grus 'jig par byed/ /rim pa 'di ni brjod par bya/ /rnam gsum lan gsum brjod pas ni/ /gsum gyis lha rnams 'tshim par bya/ /zhes sogs kyis gtor ma thun mong du byin brlabs bstan la/ de yi dbus nas blangs nas ni/ /de nas bdud rtsi myang bar bya/ /zhes sogs kyis myang ba'i tshul bstan to/ /rgyas pa phyag thig le'u bcu gnyis par 'byung zhing / lag tu blang ba ni man ngag gi skabs su shes par bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa bsten tshul ni/ thun gyi thog mtha' 'am/ thun re'am/ zla ba re la re re bsten la/ de ma grub na zla ba drug nas sam/ tha na'ang lo re'i dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes gcig gam bco lnga la re re bsten to/ /de ltar yang dus 'khor 'grel chen las/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i ril bu yungs kyi tshad tsam nyi ma so sor dam tshig bsten pa'i don du'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa phan yon ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyi rlob pa dang / tshe dang lus kyi bcud len 'gyur ba ste/ rgyud las/ rga shi'i zil gyis mi gnon zhing / /rtag tu bsrung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /sogs dang / gur las/ mi bskyod bsten pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /nad rnams thams cad rnam par spangs/ /zhes so/ /mthar thug phan yon ni/ gsang 'dus las/ sha chen dam tshig mchog gis ni/ /rdo rje gsum mchog grub par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /'di dag kyang de kho na nyid shes pas yin gyi/ gang zag gzhan gyi ni de ltar ma yin te/ dgongs pa lung ston las/ gsang ba 'dus pa mi shes par/ /sbas pa'i brtul zhugs spyod byed pa/

/khyi dang phag dang wa rnams ni/ /spyod pa dag ni ston par byed/ /ces so/ /de kho na nyid gang yin zhe na/ sbyang gzhi mtshon byed sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ sbyong byed rigs lngas sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras ye shes lnga 'byung bar shes nas nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar 'gyur ba'i phyir dag ma dag gi rnam rtog med par bstan pa ste/ gdan bzhi las/ lcags kyu che la bkod pa ni/ /ye shes lhar ni dgod pa ste/ /rdo rje lcags kyu mi bskyod pa/ /gnas kyi lcags kyu rin chen dbang / rgyal po'i lcags kyu don yod grub/ /g.yo ba'i lcags kyu 'od dpag med/ /lcags kyu lnga la sogs pa la/ /de nyid thams cad sbyar bar bya/ /zhes so/ /sha lnga la/ ci'i phyir lcags kyu zhes bya zhe na/ dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs kyis/ dngos grub thams cad 'gugs par byed pas lcags kyu'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi dam tshig tshogs 'khor la ming don dang / ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gang zag gi sgo nas dpa' bo dang dpa' mo gnyis ka 'tshogs na tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ dpa' bo 'ba' zhig 'tshogs na dpa' bo'i ston mo/ dpa' mo 'ba' zhig 'tshogs na dpa' mo'i ston mo ste/ ḍombhi was/ dpa' bo dang bral ba'i dpa' mo dang / dpa' mo dang bral ba'i dpa' bo dag gis tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ /dus kyis byed na/ dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi dus 'brel ba la tsā ru'i bza' ba'am/ dga' ston zhes bya'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas lha'i rnal 'byor rigs mi 'dra ba bsgom pa du ma 'tshogs na/ mdza' ba 'dus pa zhes bya ste/ mnyam sbyor las/ lha rnams thams cad 'tshogs pa na/ /skye bo dam pa kun 'tshogs pa/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo dam pa ni/ /mdza' ba thams cad 'dus pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi brda dag gis/ /de bzhin mdza' ba 'dus par btags/ /zhes so/ /dgos pa'i sgo nas rims dang mu ge la sogs pa zlog pa'i don du lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i gang zag 'dus nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i bkod pa ltar 'khod de/

thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gcig gi lha'i rnal 'byor bsgoms nas tshogs kyi yo byad kyis mchod de/ so so'i dam tshig la bskul ba la sangs rgyas kyi gar zhes bya'o/ /mchod bya'i sgo nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro ma mchod pa la rigs ldan ma mchod pa zhes bya/ grong gi chos kyis ma gos pa'i bu mo lhar dmigs te mchod pa la gzhon nu ma'i ston mo zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ gnas dang dus dang yo byad dang / /gang zag cho ga dgos pa'o/ /dang po la/ las dang po pa'i gnas ni/ dur khrod ri yi bya skyibs dang / /de bzhin mi med grong khyer dang / /yang na dben pa'am rgya mtsho'i mthar/ /bza' ba 'di ni rab tu bza'/ /zhes sogs dang / ḍombhi was/ dur khrod dang ni shing gcig gam/ /skyed mos tshal dang kun dga' dang / /de bzhin rang gi khyim dang ni/ /gzhan yang dben pa'i khyim rnams dang / /zhes so/ /sems brtan pa'i gnas ni/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang ni/ /tshandho nye ba'i tshandho dang / /de bzhin 'du ba nye 'du ba/ /'thung gcod nye ba'i 'thung gcod nyid/ /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod nyid/ /ces sogs dang / gnas ni dza landha rar bshad/ /de bzhin o ḍi ya na nyid/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa'i gnas so/ /gnyis pa dus la/ rgyun gyi dus ni/ rgyud las/ yi dwags zla phyed bcu bzhi dang / /de bzhin du yang brgyad pa nyid/ /sogs dang / saṃ bu ṭa las/ zla ba mar ngo'i bcu bzhi dang / /khyad par du ni brgyad pa dang / /yar gyi ngo yi bcu pa la/ /mchod pa'i mchod pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang / ḍombhi was/ yar ngo'i brgyad dang bcu gcig dang / /bco lnga dag ni rab tu bsngags/ /de bzhin mar ngo'i brgyad dang ni/ /bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga la/ /zhes so/ /khyad par gyi dus ni/ dbang rgyud rab gnas dang 'brel ba dang / nyer 'tshe zlog pa'i dus te/ gur las/ 'chi bas 'tshe'am mu ge 'am/

/phas kyi 'khor los gnod pa'am/ /rab gnas dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang / /char med pa dang zhi ba la/ /sngags dang sgom par ldan pa yis/ /gang zhig bdag ni rtag rol ba/ /de yi mdun du bdag 'dug ste/ /de ni rdzun du mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor dang gang zag mchod pa'i yo byad/ ci 'byor pa dang / med du mi rung ba kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sha dang / cho ga bzhin du btsos pa'i chang ste/ rgyud las/ rgyal mtshan dang ni mtshon bsnun dang / /lan bdun pa yang bza' bar bya/ /zhes sogs dang / skyes pa'i thod chen cha gcig par/ /chang ni bzang pos yang bkang ste/ /zhes sogs dang / ḍombhi was/ nya dang sha la sogs par ldan/ /mi 'tshe ba dang skyon kun bral/ /sdig pa med dang ma blang pa'o/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa gang zag ni/ dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog shas chung ba'i las dang po'am/ sems cung zad brtan pa yan chad/ phyag thig las/ thams cad dam tshig gcig pa dang / /thams cad rtog pa med pa dang / /ser sna nga rgyal spangs pa dang / /'dod chags zhe sdang bral ba dang / /bla ma la gus bsam gtan ldan/ /phrag dog med cing rtse gcig pa/ /de ltar dgos pa tshogs 'khor lo/ /mkhas pas 'bad de gzhug par bya/ /zhes so/ /grogs kyang las dang po pa mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pa'am/ rigs ldan ma'am/ rgyas btab pa'i gzhon nu ma'am/ ro ras la thod pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma bris pa lhar bskyed nas mchod pa ste/ saṃ ṭa las/ thod pa dgra satwa mche ba dang / /chu srin rgyal mtshan ral gri dang / /'phang mdung dung dang bdun du gsung / /yang dag sbyor ba'i cho ga 'di/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu mchod/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /drod chung 'bring che sogs thob pas ni/ rtog pa mnyam pa'am/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang brda dang brda'i lan byas nas tshogs la 'du ba ste/ phyag rgya phyag rgya'i lan gyis ni/ /dam tshig gi ni rnam par dbye/

/de la rnal 'byor mas smras pa/ /e ma bu ni snying rje che/ /gal te phreng ba lag bsten na/ /'du bar bya zhes smra ba yin/ /phreng ba mngon par btang byas nas/ /dam tshig ma mnos brtul zhugs bzang / /de la phyi rol zhes 'du ba/ /bzang po'i spyod yul gnas pa ni/ /de la 'du bar rnal 'byor mas/ /gang smras thams cad de ltar bya/ /sogs so/ /lnga pa cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ dang po la/ gnas khang brgyan te tshogs gtor bsham pa/ slob dpon nang du byon nas sngon la bzhugs pa/ sgo bas brda dang brda'i lan byas te shes nas nang tu 'jug pa/ dbang la sogs pa'i rgan rim bzhin gral bya ba/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab la yig brgyas rgyud sbyangs shing bsrung 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ḍombhi was/ sa gzhi ba yi lngas byugs la/ /me tog dri zhim sna tshogs dgram/ /zhes dang / phyag thig las/ dang po yid 'phrog dges pa yis/ /me tog dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /de rgyu sna tshogs mchod pa ni/ /rtse gcig gis ni legs par bya/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nyid bcu ni yang shes shing / /gsum po dag las dge slong mchog /'bring po dge tshul zhes bya ste/ /de dag tha mal khyim pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gal te dge slong yin yang rmongs la/ dge tshul lam/ dge bsnyen mkhas shing rgyud ston nus na/ cig shos de khyim gzhan du yo byad bzang pos mnyes par byas la/ dge tshul lam dge bsnyen gyis gtso bo bya'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan gnyis la'ang shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ phyi nas 'ong ba rnams kyis/ khyod kyi dam tshig la ni khro bo dbyug pa sngon pos mdzes/ /dngos grub phyag na dbyig tho dang ni rin chen bcing pa 'dzin/ /dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo 'du bar 'khor sgrol 'khum/ /mkhas mdzes rnal 'byor ma yin nags su bdag thongs shig /ces sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ dang po'i 'dun pa nas byung ba'i brda dang brda'i lan bya/

shes pa rnams nang du 'jug go /bzhi pa ni/ dbang dang brtul zhugs dang / ye shes dang / skye ba dang / rim pas rgan pa'i go rim bzhin gral bya ste/ ḍombhi was/ de nas slob dpon stan bzang la/ /dbus kyi phyogs su yang dag bzhugs/ /de bzhin stan ni bzang po la/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 'khor lo g.yas/ /rnal 'byor ma yi g.yon du bshad/ /ces so/ /lnga pa dang drug pa ni rtogs par sla'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor mchod pas tshim pa/ snying kha'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi myang bas tshim pa/ chos skyong dang 'byung po gtor mas tshim pa/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i skye bo kha zas kyis tshim pa/ skye mched kyi lha klu gar dang rol mos tshim pa/ bde chen lhan skyes kyi ye shes kyis tshim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud dang gur gyi dgongs pas/ dngos gzhi bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa gcig la tshim pa drug bya ba dang / saṃ ṭa'i dgongs pas bdag dang mdun skyed gnyis ka byas nas tshim pa drug bya ba ste/ gang ltar yang tshim pa drug tu thams cad 'dus so/ /gnyis pa phyag thig las/ dum bu gcig pa'i mtshan ldan snod/ /bla ma'i mdun du gzhag par bya/ /yang na dum bu gsum pa ni/ /lha yi chang gis bkang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nyid las/ bza' ba sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i/ /dang por gtor ma chen po sbyin/ /zhes dang / bzhi pa'ang / dam tshig mchog gi ye shes te/ /dad pa yis ni gta' ru bza'/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa'ang / shin tu dbyangs ni snyan pa yis/ /yid 'phrog pa yi glu blang bya/ /zhes sogs dang / drug pa'ang / dgos pa'i dam tshig zin nas su/ /'khor lo dang bcas rig rab tshim/ /zhes so/ /der dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa dang / /rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du zo/ /zhes sogs dang / bde gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags dri ma rnam par spangs/

/gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal/ /ces sogs so/ /gsum pa rjes la rdo rje'i glus byin gyis brlab pa/ bkra shis kyi tshig gis shis par brjod pa/ lhag gtor btang zhing lhag chad kha bkang ba/ smon lam gdab cing 'dod don gsol ba/ bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol ba/ bsrung ba byas nas las rjes bsdu ba'o/ /de dag kyang phyag thig las/ de rnams mchod pas dngos grub ni/ /gang zhig sems la bsam pa yod/ /lhag ma'i gtor ma bzung nas ni/ /dgon pa chen por gtang bar bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /tshul 'di dag rgyas par grub chen ḍombhi pa'i gzhung na bzhugs shing / lag tu blang ba ni man ngag gi rim pa las shes par bya'o/ /drug pa dgos pa la gtso bor gyur pa/ mthar thug gi dgos pa ste/ tshogs rdzogs nas 'tshang rgya ba ni/ gur las/ bde dang rang bzhin gar dang ni/ /glu dang rol mo'i sgra byed dang / /dri dang phreng ba byug pa yi/ /zhes sogs nas/ rig pa'i rgyal por rab tu 'grub/ /zhes dang / phyag thig las/ dam tshig bsrung na grub pa ni/ /lha yi dbang phyug rnyed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnas skabs kyi dgos pa ni/ thun mong dngos grub ci 'dod pa 'grub ste/ rgyud las/ gang du bzos pas 'dod don kun/ /'grub pa can gyi dngos grub 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /zhes bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rnam par bshad pa bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan can dang / dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rgyal ba mus pa chen po ste yongs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku du mas rjes su bzung ba'i rnal 'byor pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa rnams la brten nas rang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir legs par sbyar ba 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/

༈ /gnyis pa ni/ tshogs mchod tshogs gnyis myur 'grub shog 'byung ba bzhin la bar skabs kyi cho ga'i yan lag kha yar bsnan pa ni/ tshogs mchod kyi yi ge de nyid las/ bla ma mchod dang rnal 'byor ma/ /gnyis de zhabs la gus btud nas/ /rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i/ /tshogs mchod cho ga 'dir bshad bya/ /'dir nā ro mkha' spyod kyi tshogs mchod bya ba la/ sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying pos/ sngon 'gror/ gnas/ dus/ rten bsham pa/ mchod rdzas te bzhi dang / dngos gzhi'i cho ga rjes sogs bshad pa ltar/ dang po gnas ni/ gnas khang phyags bdar bya zhing chag chag gdab maṇḍal me tog rten dgram pa sogs dang / gnyis pa dus ni/ tshogs bsags par 'dod na yar ngo'i tshes bcu/ sgrib pa dag par 'dod na mar ngo'i tshes bcur bya bar gsungs/ gsum pa rten ni/ spro na bdag 'jug skabs ltar dkyil 'khor gsum po bshams pa'am/ yang na sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor chos 'byung sngags phreng sogs phyag len ltar dang / bsdu na me long la chang gis chos 'byung bris pa'i dbus su me tog dmar po'i tshom bu gcig bkod pa stegs la bsham/ bzhi pa mchod rdzas ni/ me tog bdug spos mar me gsum/ rten gyi g.yon du bsham/ dri chab gtor ma zhal zas gsum g.yas su/ ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba mdun du bsham mo/ /tshogs kyi yo byad ni ci 'byor pa bsham mo/ /gzhan 'di bzhin la gtor ma gsum dgos so/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ maṇḍal zhu 'bul sogs byed par gsungs pa tshogs pa yod na zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad bde kyai nas gsungs pa ltar yin kyang / rang gcig pus nyams su len par spros pa mi dgos/ cho ga gzhan rnams sa chen gyis de tsam las ma gsungs pas 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung ltar don bsdus te brjod na 'di ltar/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dmar gtor chab kyis sbran la lha'i nga rgyal gyis oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa nas ga ga na khaṃ gṛhne daṃ ba liṃ te swāhā/ lan gsum gyis bsngos/ bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las rtsom pa la bar du gcod pa ma byed par gzhan du dengs shig ces dang / sumbha brjod cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bskrad/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub bskyed pa'i se gol shar nas phyogs bzhir g.yas bskor dang mtshams bzhi g.yon du gdab cing zhal bzhi pa'i sumbha rkang pa re re brjod pa ste tshar gnyis kyis bgegs bskrad/ mdun gyi nang mchod mngon rtogs ltar byin brlabs byas te lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsir g.yon bskor du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bri zhing oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ bdud rtsi des lag pa g.yas g.yon phan tshun du gtor zhing mnye tshul bya/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis rang gi dpral mgrin snying kha gsum du thig le re bkod nas rang lus dag par byas/ gnas khang dang spyi mchod rnams la gtor bas lha rdzas las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du mchod pa rgya chen po dwangs shing thogs pa med par dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i spyir gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /skabs 'dir skyabs sems dang khyad par rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas nan tan du byas la sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor nas bzung sgrub thabs ltar mngon rtogs bzlas pa sogs dkyus bzhin bsam mi khyab kyi bar du byas te thun mtshams kyi lhar langs nas mchod rdzas rnams la nang mchod kyi bdud rtsis gtor zhing / sumbhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/

zhes sogs nas/ rgyas par gyur cig gi bar dang / oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa sgrub mchod ltar ro/ /de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gsum bkod pa'am/ sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor ram/ me long tshom bu dang bcas pa gang yin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun bskyed kyi rim pa sgrub mchod bdag 'jug gi yi ge ltar lhar bskyed pa nas bzung bstod pa'i bar bya'o/ /skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul bar gsungs pas/ dang po sgrub thabs ltar rnal 'byor ma la 'bul/ gnyis pa chos skyong ni gur zhal la gtso bor byed pa sa skya pa'i rang lugs yin/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis 'bul lo/ /de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams sgrub thabs kyi gtor ma ltar byin gyi brlabs nas/ tshogs phud tshang ba snod gcig tu bsham pa bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la 'bul te/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa/ /legs sbyar 'di ni bla ma lhar bcas la/ /dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dril bu ḍeṃ ki andar tai lo pa/ /nā ro pham thing klog skya mal lo'i zhabs/ /brtse chen snying po tshogs mchod bzhes su gsol/ /rje btsun sku mched chos rje khu dbon dang / /dkon mchog dpal dang grub chen brag phug pa/ /chos rje bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /rgyal ba mchog dbyangs tshogs mchod༞ /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rings pa dang tshar chen chos kyi rje/ /'jam mgon mkhyen brtse bslab gsum rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /dbang phyug rab brtan tshogs༞ /bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog grub dang / /mkhyen rab byams pa'i mtshan dang rmor chen rje/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma tshogs༞ /gzhan yang dpal ldan tshul khrims shar chen rje/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/

/kun dga' bzang po /rdo rje 'chang dang mus chen sems dpa' che/ /bsod nams seng ge buddha ratna'i zhabs/ /sa skya lo tsā tshogs mchod༞ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /gang gi thugs sras 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang / /sangs rgyas dpal bzang dpal ldan rgyal po'i zhabs/ /bha drwa shrī tshogs༞ /nam mkha' dbang phyug chos kyi dbang phyug dang / /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan/ a mes zhabs/ /bsod nams dbang phyug kun dga' bkra shis dang / /puṇya ratna tshogs mchod bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ ma hā gu ru badzra nai wi te āḥhūm̐/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin dngos grub 'gugs byed pa'i/ /ba glang khyi rta glang chen mi sha te/ /sgrub pa'i dam rdzas lcags kyu rnam lnga dang / /yum lnga'i rang bzhin dri chen dri chu dang / /byang sems dkar dmar sha chen dwangs ma lnga/ /zag med ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs 'di/ /lhan skyes zhing skyes sngags skyes mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum bdag he ru ka dpal dang / /rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo'i dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /āoṃ badzra a ha ra li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍa ki ni sa ma ya satwaṃ tre shya hoḥ oṃ badzra ḍā ki ni kha kha khā hī khā hi/ i maṃ bha liṃ bhu dza tha pi pa tha/ mā ma karma pā dha ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ swāhā/ lan gsum dang / oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍa ki nī ye/ badzra warṇan nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /chos skyong nor lhar bcas pa thams cad la/ /tshogs mchod gus pas 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /rang gang byed kyi yi dam dang chos skyong tshang ma'i gtor sngags mthar a kā ro btags pas phul/ tshogs chang gi phud kyang snod du blug ste/ bla ma dang lha tshogs rnams la 'bul zhing /

dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing / /rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi/ /sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas/ /rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba'i/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /sa yi snying po 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho dang / /de bzhin me tog 'bras bu'i tshogs rnams dang / /rtsi sman sna tshogs sbyar ba'i phabs dang ni/ /'gro ba'i dag byed gyur pa'i chu gtsang rnams/ /snod dang rkyen dang sna tshogs sbyor ba dang / /dus kyi 'gyur ba bzang pos yongs smin par/ /sbyangs shing dwangs ma'i dwangs ma las byung ba'i/ /'di yi rgyu rkyen phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /cher dwangs shel ltar snang ba'i lbu ba yi/ /phreng ba mu tig phreng bas spras 'dra ba/ /mthong bas mig gi dpal ster chil chil sgra/ /thos pas rna ba'i dpal la bsung ngad kyis/ /dri 'dzin dbang po tshim par byed pa yin/ /kun nas myangs pas lce yi dpal yang bde/ /grang dang tsha ba'i tshe na drod dang ni/ /bsil byed lus kyi dbang po bde ba'i rgyu/ /mya ngan 'thibs pa sel ba'i nyi ma ste/ /dga' bde'i bsil ba skyed pa'i zla ba'ang yin/ /shes rab me lce sbar byed rlung yin la/ /smra 'dod rnams kyi spobs pa'i dpal yang yin/ /g.yul ngor zhugs pa'i brtul zhugs skyed byed cing / /'dod ldan rnams kyi bde ba'ang rgyas byed yin/ /zhi 'dod rnams kyi rgyud la 'di yis ni/ /ting 'dzin dam pa lhug par skyed pa yin/ /de phyir 'di ni btung ba'i phul yang yin/ /longs spyod rnams kyi snying por gyur pa yin/ /de slad 'di ni mchod 'os mchod pa dang / /sbyin 'os rnams la sbyin par byed pa yin/ /kha dog dri ro ldan pa'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dril bu ḍeṃ ki antar tai lo pa/ /nā ro pham thing klog skya mal lo'i zhabs/

/brtse chen snying po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /rje btsun sku mched chos rje khu dbon dang / /dkon mchog dpal dang grub chen brag phug pa/ /chos rje bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /rgyal ba mchog dbyangs zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rings pa dang tshar chen chos kyi rje/ /'jam mgon mkhyen brtse bslab gsum rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /dbang phyug rab brtan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog grub dang / /mkhyen rab byams pa'i mtshan dang rmor chen rje/ /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /gzhan yang dpal ldan tshul khrims shar chen rje/ /rdo rje 'chang dang mus chen sems dpa' che/ /bsod nams seng ge buddha ratna'i zhabs/ /sa skya lo tsā'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /gang gi thugs sras 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang / /sangs rgyas dpal bzang dpal ldan rgyal po'i zhabs/ /bha drwa shrī zhal༞ /nam mkha' dbang phyug chos kyi dbang phyug dang / /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan/ /bsod nams dbang phyug kun dga' bkra shis dang / /puṇya ratna'i zhal du༞ /gzhan yang 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs khrod 'dir/ /bde gshegs bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba la/ /'gran zla bral ba'i mkhas grub ji snyed tshogs/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho sras dang slob mar bcas/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho'i srung ma drag shul can/ /'khor dang bcas la mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ /bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la/ /dngos bsham yid sprul mchod pa 'di phul bas/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rtsal du gsol/ /de nas dam tshig sbol ba'i phyir rdo rje slob dpon gyi drung du ma da na'i chang snod padma thod pa bhañdza dpral ba rang la bstan la bzhag

de'i steng du sha ba la cung zhig bzhag la las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal/ pad kor byas la/ rdo rje 'dzin sogs dgongs su gsol/ /bdag gi tshogs kyi khyad par 'di/ /dad pa'i sems kyis 'bul lags kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /zhes brjod/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ e ma zhi ba chen po kye/ /tshogs chen 'bar bas nyon mongs sreg /de 'di'i bde ba chen po ste/ /kun kyang a ho su kha che/ /a ho ma hā su kha che/ /zhes brjod/ yang phyag gsum dang pad kor byas la/ 'di ni chos rnams bzang por ltos/ /'dus pa la ni the tshom med/ /bram ze gdol pa khyi dang phag /rang bzhin gcig tu rol du gsol/ /zhes pa'i lan du/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal/ /a ho ma hā su kha ho/ /zhes brjod/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes lag pa gnyis padma'i phyag rgya las srin lag g.yas kyis steng gi ba la 'dzin pas rdo rje slob dpon nas rim bzhin ma da na 'grim tshar ba dang bar bya zhing / a ho ma hā su kha hāo/ skabs 'dir 'phags pa rin po che nas lag mchod byed par gsungs pa bde mchog ltar dgos pa ha cang rgyas drag pas/ 'dir 'phags pa'i gsung bde mchog nag po lugs kyi mchod phreng las btus pa ni lag pa g.yon pa la bdud rtsi gtor zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing mnyes nas lag mthil du sor mo lnga bsdus pa'i dbus su sen mo lnga la me tog gi thig re bkod pa zla ba'i gdan drug tu bsam pa'i mthe bor oṃ ha dkar po/ mdzub mor na ma hi ser po/ gung mo la swāhā hu dmar po/ srin lag la bai ṣaṭa he nag po/ mthe'u chung la hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar po/ sen mo lnga'i dbus su phaṭa haṃ ljang khu/ lag mthil du tshom bu lnga bkod pa zla gdan du bsams pa'i lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar po/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yas bskor gyis rim bzhin haṃ yoṃ sngon mo/

hreṃ moṃ ser mo/ hreṃ hreṃ ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams dpa' bo dpa' mo lha'i rnam par bsgom dgos kyang gsal ma thebs na yig 'bru'i rnam par bsgoms pas don lha'i rang bzhin yin no/ /lag pa'i sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams lnga ltung byed/ gsod byed/ 'gugs byed/ padma gar dbang ma/ padma'i drwa ba can ma ste snying po'i rnal 'byor ma lngar shes par bya/ de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan lag pa'i rgyab tu shar bar blta ba'am/ mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel na lag par me tog gi thig le bkod pa rdo rje rnal 'byor mar mos la/ phaiṃ zhes pho nya gsum dbyer med byed par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ gsum ma dang dpa' bo dpa' mo'i go cha'i sngags rnams gong ltar brjod/ puṣpe sogs rnam lngas mchod cing tshogs rdzas nas cung zad re lag mthil du bzhag nas mchod pas mnyes par bsam/ de nas lag pa g.yon pa la bdud rtsi gtor zhing lag pa gnyis phan tshun mnyes pas lha rnams snyoms par zhugs par bsams la/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis dpral mgrin snying khar reg cing mthar lus thams cad la byugs pas lha thams cad kyang lus la thim par bsam zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod do/ /lag mchod 'di bde mchog gi dgongs don yin la/ bsdu na gong du bshad pa'i bdud rtsis lag g.yas g.yon phan tshun du gtor mnyes byed pa/ gnas gsum thig le byed pa dpe kyang go chod par snang / de nas lag g.yon pa'i kun spyod kyi 'khrid yig tu bshad pa ltar kha zas kyi rnal 'byor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yang rung ba'i rnal 'byor gsal btab la/ nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis zhen med du tshim par longs spyad par bya'o/ /g.yeng bar mi 'gyur ba'i glu gar dang rol mo'i sgra sogs phyi nang gi lha mchod pa'i bsam pas bya zhing / dus kun bdag dang snang ba thams cad rje btsun ma'i sku dang / sgra thams cad grag stong rnal 'byor ma'i sngags dang /

bsam pa thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du dmigs la/ phyi nang gi nyams myongs bde ba thams cad kyis rnal 'byor ma mchod par bsam zhing / yang yang lha'i rnam par gsal 'debs dgos par gsungs/ de nas lhag ma bsdus pa la 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i nang nas chang gis kha phru btab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi u tsiṣṭa ba linta bhakṣa si swāhā/ lan gsum gyis sbyin/ kolla e ri sogs kyi rdo rje'i glu blangs la/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las 'byung 'gyur zhing / /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i padma rdo rjes rol mdzad pa/ /bkra shis des ni bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /mdun bskyed kyi lha la bdag gi sdig pa dang / sgrib pa dang / dam tshig gi nyes pa dang / bar du gcod pa dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang / tshe dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ 'chi ba'i tshe mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid pa dang / mthar thug bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas/ /bden pa des ni lha mo 'di dag rnams/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'i bden stobs lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa/ /des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces pa'i smon lam btab/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod gsol bya/ mdun bskyed bris 'bur gyi rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang zhes sogs dang / su pra tiṣṭhas brtan bzhugs bya/ dkyil 'khor dang sindhu ra sogs kyi rten yod na/

oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs dang / badzra muḥye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ gtor ma gsum rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bskyal/ rang gi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsrung / go cha'i sngags brjod cing rgyas btab la nyal ba'i spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor chos bzhin du bya'o/ /phan yon ni/ 'phags pa rin po ches/ de ltar rgyun du rnal 'byor du byed pa ni sdig pa dang dam tshig gi nyes pa 'dag pa dang / lha dang bla ma'i thugs dam bskang zhing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa dge sogs ris med bstan pa rin po che mtshungs med chos kyi spyan ldan zhi ba lha sprul pa'i sku 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan nas gsung bris gnang rten bzang po dang bcas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs mchod kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bzhed srol bzhin la 'bul tshig sogs rgyas pa yod pa zhig dang / rdo rje'i glu bod skad du bsdebs pa zhig dgos zhes bkas bskul yang / rnam g.yeng le lo'i dbang gis lo zla du mar cham bskur lta bur lus mod/ slar dam pa rnams kyi thugs bzhed rnam dkar la ji snyam du yang mi sems par lus na rang nyid ngan 'gro'i rgyu las ma 'das pas/ de sogs nyes pa mtha' dag bshags pa'i phyir du sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dam pa mang pos mdzad pa'i tshogs mchod yi ge rnams lhan cig du bkod pa 'di la nyes tshogs med snyam yang skyes sbyang gi blo gros dman pa'i khar rnam g.yeng le lo'i bab col mchis na skyabs gnas dam pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad nas dge des 'gro kun mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/ ༈ /dpal kyai rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje'i glu'i dgongs don bod skad du bsdebs pa bzhugs so//

oṃ swasti/ dpal kyai rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje'i glu'i dgongs don bod skad du bsdebs pa ni/ kwa ye bde ba'i gnas dang bo lā dag /kyai zhing dang kakko la sbyar ba/ /tshogs su cang ti ba ni dkrol bar bya/ /snying rjes gnas pa'i ca co mi bya'o/ /de yi dus su stob ni bza' bar bya/ /'bad pas myos byed btung bar bya'o/ /kwa ye skal ldan nang du gzhug par bya/ /skal ba med pa spangs pa nyid du bya/ /zhi nyams gla rtsi dang ni sihla dang / /ga pur rnams ni byug pa nyid du bshad/ /pā li las ni skyes pa dag tshod ma/ /dus mngar lto ba gang ba bza' bar bya/ /'ong ba dang ni 'gro bar byed pa na/ /dag dang mi dag par ni mi blta'o/ /cha shas med pa lus la gdags par bya/ /dpe der skyes pa'i ro ni dbul bar bya/ /'dus te snyoms par 'jug pa byed pa na/ /reg min de dus spang bar mi bya'o/ /zhes rdo rje glu'i mchan rnying pa na bshad 'dug kyang / 'di ni nges par rgya skad du 'don dgos pa rje btsun gong ma rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i phyag len yin pa'ang dgongs 'jags zhu// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 16 kun dga' blo gros/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs mchod zab don snying khu/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 15
